eps.t: The Sagacious Wisdom of Cognitive Computing: Cooking Chapter
eps.ov: Mayuri and Kurisu attempt to make some fried chicken with help of a cognitive computing-based Upa terminal, only to find they lack the actual ingredients they need. Thus, with Upa's help, they find something they can make with what they have in the lab.

eps.t: The Sagacious Wisdom of Cognitive Computing: Navigation Chapter
eps.ov: After Rintaro and Kurisu get into an argument with each other, they both use Upa to try and navigate their way home without bumping into each other. Instead, Upa arranges them to take the long route so they can make up with each other.

eps.t: The Sagacious Wisdom of Cognitive Computing: Fashion Chapter
eps.ov: When it becomes apparent that Rintaro and Daru pretty much wear the same clothes all the time, Kurisu uses Upa to try and come up with some different outfits for them based on their hobbies and personalities.

eps.t: The Sagacious Wisdom of Cognitive Computing: Meeting Chapter
eps.ov: Following complaints from Yugo, Upa heads up a meeting concerning a potential new location for the lab, much to Rintaro's dismay.
